# Portal Roadmap Skill

Create execution-ready roadmaps for portal evolution from strategy to sprint backlog.

## When to Use This Skill

- User asks for feature prioritization or roadmap sequencing
- Need epics and stories for release planning
- Need acceptance criteria tied to outcomes/KPIs
- Need sprint slicing for near-term execution

## Workflow

1. Define objective and success KPIs.
2. Group capabilities into epics.
3. Prioritize using value/risk/effort.
4. Sequence into phased releases.
5. Produce sprint-ready stories and acceptance criteria.

## Output Template

- Objective
- KPI Targets
- Release Phases
- Epics per phase
- User stories (with acceptance criteria)
- Risks and mitigations
- Next 3 sprints
